headline: China's open GLM-5.3-Flash and Nvidia's record quarter
body: Five small stories, mostly balancing out. China's Z.ai released GLM-5.3-Flash, a 320B open-weight model under an MIT licence; open models spread capability around, easing Power Concentration and helping the Libertarian and Egalitarian utopias. Nvidia's record $96.2 billion quarter added to Capability Velocity. The Guardian exposed an influence operation trying to seed AI chatbots with propaganda, raising Surveillance & Control and lifting 1984. Meta scrapping part of an 'AI-native' plan to cut teams was a small plus for Shared Prosperity. Sam Altman said OpenAI is '80%' to AGI while holding its biggest run until safety controls are ready. Horizon Balance: -2.66.
movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia +0.1, mostly from Z.ai's open GLM-5.3-Flash (+0.07) and Meta dropping its 'AI-native' cuts (+0.05). Libertarian Utopia +0.1, from Z.ai's open GLM-5.3-Flash (+0.10) and fading earlier news (+0.02). 1984 +0.08, from the chatbot propaganda story (+0.17) and fading earlier news (+0.02), partly offset by Z.ai's open GLM-5.3-Flash (-0.07) and smaller items (-0.04).
